method: Native Windows UI Automation SetFocus on the live NumericField input; then SetFocus on a different live input. The parent demo callback counters were read from the native UIA tree after each transition.
scope: Confirms both public EventCallback parameters OnFocus and OnBlur are invoked in the real Windows browser through native focus transitions. The headless CDP probe does not synthesize native focus/focusin transitions reliably, so it asserts browser registration of Blazor focusin/focusout handlers; this native UIA interaction is the behavioral evidence.
